body:
## What does this PR do?

Add Microsoft Teams **emoji reactions** (inbound + outbound / processing-lifecycle 👀✅❌) without the files/Graph work.

**Companion (files + Graph, stacked — merge this first):** will link in a follow-up comment / see related PR from the same fork.

Fork source: https://github.com/tournierjc/hermes-agent/pull/3

### Reactions

- **Processing status** (default on; `TEAMS_REACTIONS=false` or `extra.reactions: false` to disable): 👀 while the agent works, then ✅ on success or ❌ on failure.
- **Agent-facing** `send_message` `action="react"` / `"unreact"`: not gated by `TEAMS_REACTIONS`. Unicode and Teams reaction ids both work.
- Inbound `messageReaction` activities → gateway hooks (`reaction:added` / `reaction:removed`). The bot ignores its own reactions.
- SDK `api.reactions.add` / `delete` with Bot Framework REST fallback.

This PR does **not** include FileConsent, Graph uploads, or `MSGRAPH_*`.

## Type of Change

- [x] ✨ New feature
- [x] 📝 Documentation update
- [x] ✅ Tests

## How to Test

```bash
scripts/run_tests.sh tests/gateway/test_teams.py -k 'reaction or Reaction'
```

Live: react/unreact from the agent; confirm processing 👀 then ✅/❌.

## Checklist

- [x] Conventional Commits
- [x] Reaction-only scope
- [x] Tests + docs
